news.paragraph: The United States Oil Fund (USO) has seen significant gains in 2026, with articles highlighting its doubling in value due to supply scares and a recovery in capacity. While crude oil prices have held around $100, the ETF is now navigating a complex landscape of potential supply disruptions and capacity recovery. The narrative suggests a tug-of-war between bullish supply-side pressures and a more balanced outlook as production potentially catches up.
